query: In summary, using an unbiased biochemical approach to probe the transcriptional regulation of the Nanog gene by OCT4 and SOX2, we uncovered an unanticipated transcriptional coactivator role of the DKC1 complex and a subset of its associated snoRNAs in ES and iPS cells.
